criteria.requirement: Add FileUpload.save_atomic(destination, *, overwrite=False, chunk_size=65536) for real path/directory targets. Complete copying in a private same-directory temporary file before publication; overwrite=True atomically replaces, False uses exclusive publication that cannot overwrite a competitor. Restore original input cursor on success and read/write/replace failures, preserve existing destination bytes on failures, clean only owned temporary files and validate positive chunk sizes. Leave existing save/stream behavior unchanged and do not claim crash durability.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
